tools.name: delegate_to_model
tools.description: Pick which EXISTING model should handle a task. Inspects task complexity and returns the best-fit model from the routing registry — does NOT add a new model. Read-only. (For drafting a registry entry for a new model, use `registry_import`.)

tools.name: orchestrate
tools.description: Orchestrate a task by analyzing it, breaking it into subtasks if needed, and coordinating expert agents

tools.name: create_expert
tools.description: Create a specialized expert agent for code, architecture, security, documentation, testing, devops, research, product management, UX, or infrastructure tasks

tools.name: execute_expert
tools.description: Run a task through an expert YOU PREVIOUSLY CREATED via `create_expert`. Requires the expertId returned by create_expert; not for ad-hoc execution. Returns the expert analysis including output, confidence, and token usage.

task.description: Task description for the expert to execute

context.description: Additional context metadata for the task

timeoutMs.description: Optional timeout in ms (120s-900s). Overrides auto-detected timeout.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run a LINEAR (single-path) workflow template by name with typed inputs. For DAG-shaped workflows with branching, checkpoints, or rollback, use `run_graph_workflow` instead.

template.description: Workflow template name (e.g., code-review) or file path

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Inventory of multi-step TEMPLATES available to `run_workflow` (code-review, security-audit, etc.). Use this BEFORE run_workflow to pick a template; returns template name, version, description, category, and required inputs.

format.description: Output format: full (with details) or names (just template names)

tools.name: research_query
tools.description: Query the research registry for technique status, overlaps, statistics, or text search. Provides read-only access to the research tracking system.

action.description: Query action: status, overlap, stats, or search

query.description: Search query string for search action

tools.name: research_add
tools.description: PAPER-only: add an arXiv preprint to the research registry by arXiv ID. Fetches metadata from arxiv.org and persists to the registry. For non-paper sources (GitHub repos, tools, blogs) use `research_add_source` instead. Use dryRun=true to preview without saving.

topic.description: Research topic to categorize the paper under

tools.name: research_add_source
tools.description: NON-PAPER source: add a GitHub repo / tool / blog URL to the research registry. Auto-computes quality_score from provided quality_signals. For arXiv papers use `research_add` instead. Use dryRun=true to preview without saving.

tools.name: research_discover
tools.description: Discover new research papers and repositories from external sources. Searches arXiv, GitHub, and other sources. Filters out items already in the registry.

relevanceThreshold.description: Minimum relevance score (0-1) to include results. Higher = stricter filtering.

tools.name: research_analyze
tools.description: Analyze the research registry for gaps, trends, priorities, stale entries, or coverage. Returns structured analysis with recommendations.

tools.name: research_catalog_review
tools.description: Review auto-cataloged research references found during tool execution. List pending references, approve them for registry addition, dismiss, or clear all.

action.description: Action to perform on cataloged references

tools.name: research_synthesize
tools.description: Synthesize the research registry by grouping papers into topic clusters. Returns structured summaries with common themes, key insights, techniques, implementation opportunities, and cross-cutting themes across clusters.

topic.description: Optional topic filter for single-cluster synthesis

tools.name: survey_oss_landscape
tools.description: Transient OSS project search. Returns a ranked list of GitHub repositories with license, last-commit, star-count, and one-line description. Does NOT persist to the research registry — use `research_add_source` for that. Best for one-off engineering decisions like "what tools exist in this space?".

query.description: Free-text search query, e.g. "cargo nextest replacement" or "OSS SBOM tools"

minStars.description: Minimum star count to include (default 0; useful for filtering noise)

tools.name: vendor_publishing_audit
tools.description: Look up a vendor's published-artifact signing infrastructure: GPG key fingerprints, SHA256SUMS URL pattern, signature shape (clearsigned / detached / detached-on-iso), release cadence, key rotation notes, and the vendor doc citation. Static lookup against a curated seed dataset; the vendor doc URL is the authoritative source. Returns `{known: false, knownVendors: [...]}` for vendors without a seed entry. v1 covers ubuntu, debian, fedora.

tools.name: compare_data_feeds
tools.description: Diff two upstream data feeds (YAML or JSON files) along coverage and per-field axes. Returns which entries exist in A, B, both, plus optional field-level diffs across matched entries. v1 takes file paths only (no URL fetch — that needs an SSRF design pass). Both feeds must be a top-level array OR a top-level object with exactly one array field.

feedAPath.description: Filesystem path to feed A (YAML or JSON, auto-detected by extension)

keyPath.description: Dotted path to the entry key, e.g. "id" or "name". Each entry must have this field.

compareFields.description: Optional dotted field paths to compare across matched entries (e.g. ["license", "sha256"])

tools.name: memory_query
tools.description: Query across all memory backends (session, belief, agentic, adaptive, typed) with unified results. Returns memories matching the query with source attribution and relevance scores.

query.description: Search query to match against memory contents

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Get memory system statistics dashboard. Shows backend availability, entry counts, and decay stats across all 7 memory backends.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Write a memory entry to a specific backend. Supports session (learnings), belief (subject-predicate-object triples), agentic (knowledge with attributes), adaptive (priority-scored), and typed (MIRIX-style semantic) backends.

backend.description: Target memory backend: session (learnings), belief (triples), agentic (knowledge), adaptive (priority-scored), typed (MIRIX-style semantic)

tools.name: consensus_vote
tools.description: Execute multi-model consensus voting on a proposal. Uses 7 specialized agent roles (architect, security, devex, ai_ml, pm, catfish, scope_steward) to vote on proposals with configurable strategies. Supports higher_order strategy for Bayesian-optimal aggregation with correlation awareness (Issue #514).

strategy.description: Voting strategy: simple_majority (default), supermajority, unanimous, proof_of_learning, or higher_order

simulateVotes.description: TESTS ONLY — random output, must not be used for real decisions (#2319)

tools.name: weather_report
tools.description: Get multi-CLI performance weather report. Shows per-CLI success rates, per-category breakdowns, and adaptive routing bonus recommendations based on observed task outcomes.

tools.name: improvement_review
tools.description: Periodic threshold-gated observability-driven improvement loop. Reads OutcomeStore + fitness audit, surfaces patterns crossing documented thresholds as candidate findings. When fileIssues=true, files candidate GitHub issues via `gh issue create` (rate-limited to 5 per run, deduped against open issues). Never auto-merges. Replaces the deleted self-development engine (#2402).

lookbackDays.description: Lookback window for outcome data, in days. Default 7.

fileIssues.description: When true, file candidate issues for crossed thresholds (default false — return signals only)

minSampleSize.description: Minimum sample size before a CLI/category signal fires (default 5).

fitnessFloor.description: Fitness score below this threshold triggers a tech-debt signal (default 90).

tools.name: registry_import
tools.description: Draft a registry ENTRY for a NEW model so routing can consider it later. Generates a ModelCapability YAML with conservative quality scores (5/10) for human review. For picking among ALREADY-registered models, use `delegate_to_model`. Use dryRun=true (default) to preview the entry without saving.

tools.name: repo_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a GitHub repository structure. Returns language, framework, package manager, CI provider, security tooling, Dockerfile/Helm/Makefile detection, and gap identification. Replaces multi-step manual inspection with a single structured query.

repo.description: GitHub repository in "owner/name" format or full URL

depth.description: Analysis depth: shallow (tree + README) or deep

tools.name: repo_security_plan
tools.description: Generate a security scanning pipeline recommendation for a GitHub repository. Analyzes repo structure, detects languages/frameworks, and recommends specific vulnerability scanners with CI config snippets. Powered by the vulnerability scanner registry with provenance-tracked metrics.

repo.description: GitHub repository in "owner/name" format or full URL

tools.name: issue_triage
tools.description: Triage a GitHub issue using the full security pipeline. Classifies the issue, assesses author trust and reputation, proposes labels and actions, and validates all outputs through policy gate and corroboration checks. Read-only by default. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN environment variable, or gh CLI auth.

tools.name: run_graph_workflow
tools.description: Run a DAG-shaped workflow with per-node checkpoints, rollback, event streaming, and audit trail. Use for multi-step pipelines where intermediate state must survive failures. For straight linear templates, use `run_workflow` instead.

workflow.description: Workflow name: echo, pipeline, code-review, security-scan. Use "list" for available workflows.

tools.name: execute_spec
tools.description: Execute a markdown specification through the full pipeline: parse, decompose into task DAG, compile to graph, execute, validate against acceptance criteria, and analyze failures.

spec.description: Markdown specification to execute. Must contain "## Requirements" and "## Acceptance Criteria" sections.

tools.name: list_experts
tools.description: Inventory of expert ROLES available to `create_expert` (architect, security, devex, etc.). Use this BEFORE create_expert to pick a role; returns role name, capability summary, default model.

format.description: Output format: full (with details) or names (just role names)

tools.name: query_trace
tools.description: Query execution traces by run ID. Returns agent and model attribution for pipeline runs including decision paths, error taxonomy, and timing data.

runId.description: Run ID to query traces for

tools.name: query_task_state
tools.description: Read the structured state log for a task ID and return the current snapshot. Includes Magentic-One Task Ledger (facts/guesses/openQuestions) and Progress Ledger (per-step reflections with suggestedAction) when orchestrators have written them. Structured state is only written when NEXUS_TASK_STATE_ENABLED=1 was set during the orchestrate invocation.

taskId.description: Task ID whose structured state log should be read

tools.name: verify_audit_chain
tools.description: Verify the hash chain of a persisted FileAuditStorage audit log. Reads all `audit-*.jsonl` files in the given directory, parses events, and runs `verifyChain()` to detect tampering. Returns a structured result with eventCount, fileCount, and one of three tamper signals if detected (hash_mismatch, previous_hash_mismatch, missing_hash). Read-only — never writes or deletes events.

logDir.description: Filesystem path to the FileAuditStorage log directory. Tool reads all `audit-*.jsonl` files and verifies the combined hash chain.

tools.name: extract_symbols
tools.description: Parse a SINGLE TypeScript/JavaScript file with tree-sitter and return its structural AST symbols. Use when you need the structure of one file — function/class/method/interface/type definitions. Not a cross-file search; for that use `search_codebase`. Output is 80%+ smaller than reading the full file.

mode.description: index (default): names+lines. full: includes source text

tools.name: search_codebase
tools.description: Cross-file ripgrep-style search across the working directory. Builds an in-memory symbol index and ranks matches with relevance scoring. Use when you need usages of a symbol or pattern across MANY files. For the AST of a single file, use `extract_symbols` instead. Modes: search (find by keyword), summary (per-file overview), list (all indexed files).

tools.name: run_dev_pipeline
tools.description: Run the multi-agent development pipeline. Accepts direct task instructions, a plan file, or a spec file. Supports dry-run (plan+vote only).

planFile.description: Path to a plan/spec file to use as input

dryRun.description: If true, stop after plan+vote (no implementation)

maxQaIterations.description: Max QA review iterations per task

issueNumber.description: GitHub issue to post progress to

repo.description: GitHub repo for issue tracking (e.g., owner/repo)

trackerBackend.description: Task tracking backend for issue creation

simulateVotes.description: TESTS ONLY — random output, must not be used for real decisions (#2319)

votingStrategy.description: Voting strategy for plan approval (default: higher_order)

quickMode.description: Use 3 agents instead of 6 for faster consensus voting

timeoutMs.description: Max time per stage in ms (30000-600000). Default: varies by stage complexity

mode.description: 'autonomous': full pipeline. 'harness': stops after decompose, returns tasks for caller to implement.

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: Single unified entry point for all pipeline templates (dev/research/audit/greenfield/general). Auto-detects template from task content or accepts an explicit override.

task.description: Task description — pipeline template auto-selected based on content

specFile.description: Path to a spec file — content prepended to task for greenfield projects

template.description: Pipeline template override. Available: dev, research, audit, greenfield, general

votingStrategy.description: Voting strategy for plan approval. simple_majority (default), supermajority (67%), unanimous, higher_order (Bayesian), proof_of_learning, opinion_wise

quickMode.description: Use 3 agents instead of 6 for faster consensus voting

timeoutMs.description: Max time per stage in ms (30000-600000). Default: varies by stage complexity

simulateVotes.description: TESTS ONLY — random output, must not be used for real decisions (#2319)
